title: xStocks launch on Solana via Kraken and Bybit
description: Backed Finance's xStocks suite (60+ tokenized US equities and ETFs) goes live for non-US users on Kraken and Bybit, with freely transferable SPL tokens on Solana and day-one DeFi integrations (Raydium, Jupiter, Kamino).

title: Robinhood announces EU stock tokens on Arbitrum
description: Robinhood launches 200+ US stock and ETF tokens for EU customers as derivative-wrapped tokens on Arbitrum, announces plans for its own Robinhood Chain. OpenAI publicly disputes the 'OpenAI token' shortly after — a reminder of disclosure risk in derivative-model tokens.

title: Ondo Global Markets launches 100+ tokenized US stocks and ETFs
description: Ondo GM goes live with 1:1 custodied tokenized equities (TICKERon convention) for non-US users, with mint/redeem against underlying shares.

title: SEC Project Crypto announced
description: SEC chairman announces 'Project Crypto' initiative to modernize securities rules for on-chain markets, including guidance paths for tokenized equities — a key watch item for US-accessible tokenized stocks.

title: MiCA transition deadlines tighten EU distribution
description: EU CASP licensing transition affects distribution of tokenized equity products to EEA retail; issuers relying on prospectus exemptions review their frameworks.
